title: RA-412: Add WasteProcessingType filter support to work-items query
description: Backend piece of RA-412: management-fe mislabels every Exporter application as Reprocessor because the applicant-type filter has no way to filter on payload.wasteProcessingType. Add a WasteProcessingTypes filter param to WorkItemQuery, add matching clause to BuildFilter in WorkItemPersistence.cs (mirroring existing Nations/payload.nation pattern), and wire the param through the query-binding layer and work-items list endpoint. See c:\Users\moasa\Downloads\RA-412.md for full context; this repo's scope is the 3 items listed under epr-register-enrol-management-be in the Implementation plan section.
